result.summary: Updates the Guix time-machine pinned commit to a newer upstream revision and adjusts deterministic build manifests for newer toolchain components. It upgrades binutils to 2.47 and CMake to 4.3.3, switches linker warning handling to CMake's native CMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR flag, drops the custom osslsigncode package definition in favor of upstream Guix, and disables fixincludes on gcc-sans-libc.
result.problem: The Guix build environment lags behind upstream Guix package releases, missing newer compiler toolchains (such as Clang 22/23 and GCC 16) and relying on deprecated package imports and temporary local package definitions.
evidence: PR description documents toolchain updates: binutils 2.46 -> 2.47, cmake 3.31.10 -> 4.3.3, linux-libre-headers 6.1.172 -> 6.1.187, lief 0.17.6 -> 1.0.0, and availability of Clang 22/23 and GCC 16
Commit a84f2f8672 cites Guix warning: 'manifest_build.scm:279:8: warning: ninja is deprecated, use (@ (gnu packages build-tools) ninja) instead'
result.scope_notes: Touches Guix deterministic build manifests and linting requirements; does not touch core node source code.
result.changed_since_previous: No substantive changes to the approach or diff contents.
result.card: Updates the Guix time-machine pinned commit to a newer upstream revision and updates toolchains in deterministic build manifests. It upgrades binutils to 2.47, switches to CMake 4.3.3, adopts CMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR, updates lief to 1.0.0, and reverts custom osslsigncode overrides in favor of upstream Guix. This keeps release binaries reproducible on modern toolchains and makes GCC 16 and Clang 22/23 available.

risk.why: Alters toolchain versions and build flags used to produce deterministic release binaries, which could introduce binary discrepancies or target platform build failures.
